ENTOMOLOGICAL & CHEMICAL DEFENSE DEPTH

Chemical Foam Chemistry: Name the mechanism directly. Aposematic Coloration: Frame the bold adult yellow/orange/black pattern and juvenile black/red stripe explicitly as aposematic warning coloration that signals unpalatability to bird and reptile predators.

Etymology: Note that "lubber" derives from an Old English word meaning clumsy or lazy, highlighting its heavy, slow-moving build.
